verdict.rationale: A background-automation story is a fair question for an auth SaaS, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no scheduled jobs or autonomous background workflows. Auth hooks run Postgres functions at sign-in lifecycle points, and database triggers can link auth data to your tables. These are event-driven building blocks inside the auth flow, not automations that run on their own, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
